about: Rosenbaum Meier Personal Injury Lawyers is a New York City personal injury firm with offices in Manhattan, Brooklyn and the Bronx.

The firm states that consultations are free and that it works on a contingency fee basis, with no attorney's fees owed unless and until it recovers compensation. It publishes a 24-hour intake line and service in English and Spanish.

G1.evidence: 9 of 11 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way

G2.evidence: None of the 9 named attorneys carries a disciplinary status on the public register: no disbarment, suspension or disciplinary resignation. Those statuses persist, so the check reaches back years, but it would not show a censure or a suspension since lifted.
